description: NaPO₃ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4₁/a space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.98 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.49-1.65 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent P atoms.
